LocalFallback._Note: StorageFlag: Controls whether the private key is persisted to disk (MachineKeySet/UserKeySet) or kept strictly in RAM (EphemeralKeySet). Defaults to EphemeralKeySet if missing. Use EphemeralKeySet for Linux/Docker/Azure, MachineKeySet for Windows IIS. Supports comma-separated strings via Enum.Parse. NOTE ON OVERRIDING: In secondary providers (like secrets.json), do NOT set Certificates to null to clear this array, as .NET configuration merging will preserve these indices. Use an empty array '[]' instead to completely reset the collection locally.

ForwardedHeaderOptions.ForwardedHeaders_Comment: 15 = For(1) + Host(2) + Proto(4) + Prefix(8). Set to 15 because the BFF gateway must capture outer base path prefixes from the edge proxy.
ForwardedHeaderOptions.ForwardLimit_Comment: Set to null to disable the hop limit completely. If the total number of proxies is known (e.g., 2 for Cloudflare -> YARP), set this to that exact figure to prevent header spoofing attacks.
ForwardedHeaderOptions.TrustedProxyIPs_Comment: Add specific static IPs of standalone load balancers, corporate firewalls, or local loopbacks.
ForwardedHeaderOptions.TrustedProxyNetworks_Comment: Add CIDR ranges for dynamic multi-instance environments (like Kubernetes pods, dynamic YARP containers, or internal VPC subnets).
